answer: Each epoch the full roster of identities is folded into one Merkle root and burned as a paid commitment on a separate settlement chain — a fingerprint set hard as jade that no local node can quietly re-carve. To backdate a sybil you must forge an older lineage and re-anchor it with real outside gas, which the very next honest commitment overwrites, so the forgery never sets. That external fee is the bitter nectar every fake drinks alone: 1000 clones mean 1000 separately-paid anchors, strictly linear, none refunded, so mass-minting buys no durable history.
